response.message: Now on field 'mailing city, state, and country'. It already has a confirmed answer -- read the current value back and ask what the user wants to change it to.
response.field_guidance: ID: mailing_city_state_country | Spoken: mailing city, state, and country | Type: text | Required: true | Instructions: Give the city or town, the state or province, and the country for your mailing address, including the ZIP code or postal code where appropriate. This must be a complete address, because the IRS uses it to mail back your original documents and your number notice. | Official reference text: Line 2. Enter your complete mailing address on line 2. This is the address the IRS will use to return your original documents and send written notification of your ITIN application status. | Fill language: English | Speak English aloud -- respond UNMISTAKABLY in English
